metadata.question: Did Wilmington, North Carolina receive at least 90 inches of rainfall during the year of 2018?

data.raw_code: 1. Search strategy: Use CHIRPS (Climate Hazards Group InfraRed Precipitation with Station data) dataset for rainfall data. The collection is 'UCSB-CHG/CHIRPS/DAILY' or 'UCSB-CHG/CHIRPS/PENTAD' for pentadal data. I'll use the daily collection and sum over 2018. 2. Masking strategy: No cloud masking needed for CHIRPS as it's precipitation data. 3. Logic: - Define Wilmington, NC as a point geometry with buffer - Filter CHIRPS for 2018 - Check if collection is empty (C1) - Sum precipitation values for the year - Check if valid pixels exist (C2) - Validate the result is reasonable (not NaN, within expected range) - Convert mm to inches (CHIRPS is in mm, 1 inch = 25.4 mm) - Check if >= 90 inches CHIRPS data: daily precipitation in mm 90 inches = 90 * 25.4 = 2286 mm ```javascript const ee = require('@google/earthengine'); const privateKey = require('../auth_keys/test-project-473922-29f05d49bed7'); async function runAnalysis() { // 1. Geometry & Time Definitions const wilmington = ee.Geometry.Point([-77.9447, 34.2257]).buffer(5000); // 5km buffer around Wilmington, NC const startDate = '2018-01-01'; const endDate = '2018-12-31'; // 2. Data Acquisition & Check const chirps = ee.ImageCollection('UCSB-CHG/CHIRPS/DAILY') .filterDate(startDate, endDate) .filterBounds(wilmington); const collectionSize = chirps.size().getInfo(); console.log(`2018 CHIRPS Images: ${collectionSize}`); if (collectionSize === 0) { console.log("C1"); return; } // 3. Processing - Sum annual precipitation const annualPrecip = chirps.sum(); // Check valid pixels const pixelCount = annualPrecip.reduceRegion({ reducer: ee.Reducer.count(), geometry: wilmington, scale: 5000, maxPixels: 1e9 }).get('precipitation').getInfo(); console.log(`Valid pixels: ${pixelCount}`); if (pixelCount === 0) { console.log("C2"); return; } // 4. Calculation - Get mean precipitation in mm const precipMm = annualPrecip.reduceRegion({ reducer: ee.Reducer.mean(), geometry: wilmington, scale: 5000, maxPixels: 1e9 }).get('precipitation').getInfo(); // 5. Validation & Final Answer console.log(`Annual precipitation: ${precipMm?.toFixed(1)} mm`); if (precipMm === null || precipMm === undefined || isNaN(precipMm)) { console.log("C3"); return; } // Convert mm to inches (1 inch = 25.4 mm) const precipInches = precipMm / 25.4; console.log(`Annual precipitation: ${precipInches?.toFixed(1)} inches`); // Validate reasonable range (0-200 inches = 0-5080 mm) if (precipMm < 0 || precipMm > 5080) { console.log("C3"); return; } if (precipInches >= 90) { console.log("A"); } else { console.log("B"); } } async function initEE() { await new Promise((resolve, reject) => { ee.data.authenticateViaPrivateKey(privateKey, resolve, reject); }); await new Promise((resolve, reject) => { ee.initialize(null, null, resolve, reject); }); await runAnalysis(); } initEE(); ```
